skill.summary: Five Below offers a dynamic treasure-hunt shopping experience with mostly $5-and-under products to engage and retain Gen Z teens.

latestVersion.changelog:
Five Below skill version 1.0.0 introduces an in-depth exploration of how the brand captivates Gen Z with its "treasure hunt" shopping experience.

- Explains Five Below’s unique retail model targeting highly price-sensitive, young consumers
- Analyzes the psychological appeal of ever-changing product assortments
- Details store metrics, growth trajectory, and the shift to higher price points via "$5 Beyond"
- Contextualizes Five Below’s rise within broader discount retail and post-pandemic shopping trends
